deployment.commit_message:
GAP-FILL: reconcile routes/server.approvals.js after origin/main merge for business-tools step 6. An origin/main merge introduced deps.requireKey and deps.logger usage inside the route but left the signature as (app), which would cause runtime errors. Reconciled the file to export registerApprovalRoutes as (app, deps = {}) with safe fallbacks for requireKey and logger, preserving the setTimeout-based 48h auto-reject scheduler and the required BUILD_QUEUE substrings. Updated business-tools product home SSOT. HAND-AUTHORED-JUSTIFICATION: deterministic merge-conflict gap-fill on an existing builder-generated route; factory /build attempts failed with BLOCKED_TOOLING due to exhausted AI provider quota, and only the function signature and fallback wiring were adjusted.

Co-Authored-By: Devin AI <158243242+devin-ai-integration[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
